weapon.description: All weapon item families eligible for Runebound Loot affixes.
notes: Only Barony weapon families listed above receive affixes. Armor, rings, amulets, scrolls, potions, and other non-weapon items are excluded.
Family names must match Barony's internal item family identifiers.
This file is BML-owned dynamic data. Stock Barony cannot load it as standalone behavior.
Live gameplay is not verified; this data is self-test scaffolding only.
